purpose: Census every descriptive organ against exact installed executable-package evidence and compile an explicitly supplied implementation package into a detached Forge-ready or materialized-and-tested organ candidate without inventing source or installing it.

properties.anatomy_id: prepare/materialize: one exact ID from the 415 descriptive organ records; census: optional exact filter
properties.domain_code: census only; optional exact domain filter
properties.state: census only; optional CONNECTED_EXECUTABLE_PACKAGE, EXECUTABLE_PACKAGE_WITH_MISSING_INTERFACES, or IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED filter
properties.limit: census only; optional result bound from 1 through 415
properties.package: prepare/materialize only; complete explicit axm.executable-software-organ/v0.1 package source that cites the selected anatomy ID
properties.path: materialize-and-test only; detached candidate directory under creations/ or outside the live machine body
properties.replace: materialize-and-test only; optional explicit detached-target replacement boolean

contains: separate descriptive, executable-package, interface-coverage, detached-test, and installation states
all 415 exact anatomy rows or an explicit filtered page for census
closed Forge proposal compiled only from caller-supplied implementation source for prepare
spawn and bounded organ-package test evidence for materialize-and-test

relationships: connects every descriptive organ record to an explicit observed materialization state
verifies that each standalone organs/ record exactly matches the canonical registry record
measures installed package connectivity only through exact declared interfaces and shared project types
requires complete explicit package source instead of generating arbitrary semantic implementation
compiles package identity, interfaces, template files, anatomy lineage, deterministic checks, limitations, zero authority, and four-root fit into the existing Forge contract
keeps detached materialization and test separate from installation, registration, promotion, semantic runtime proof, and live-machine connection

anatomy_refs.basis: The census resolves each installed organ's required interfaces only against exact compatible installed providers and exposes unresolved edges.
The compiler delegates exact detached package materialization and bounded testing to the existing Creation-Unit Forge.
Canonical registry records, standalone source equality, installed refs, exact interfaces, supplied source, and test receipts remain separate visible evidence.

limitations: the current census observes three installed executable packages and does not relabel the remaining descriptive anatomy records as executable
a package implementation must be supplied explicitly by a human, AI, recipe, or labelled external source; arbitrary semantic source synthesis is not implemented
exact interface coverage proves structural provider availability, not semantic interface conformance or runtime behavior
materialize-and-test validates the executable-organ package and deterministic file evidence but does not execute emitted project runtime behavior
detached candidates are not installed, registered, promoted, merged, connected to the live library, or granted authority by this capability
persistent_state: census and prepare are read-only; materialize-and-test writes only the caller-selected detached candidate directory

truth.basis: All 415 descriptions, exact source equality, installed package mappings, structural connectivity, missing implementations, supplied source, and unproven behavior remain separately visible.

agency.basis: A caller chooses each implementation and target anatomy; the compiler does not invent source, install candidates, or grant them authority.

continuity.basis: New organ bodies remain detached and recoverable until the existing separately justified adoption transition is chosen.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The complete census makes the 412 real implementation gaps visible, while exact package validation and bounded tests precede connection to the live library.
